draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 135th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 21st of 36 at WR. He lasted until pick 195, well after his grade rank (135th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Will Fuller. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (84th percentile). Testing concerns: vertical jump (9th percentile). College production: 719 receiving yards in 2025, 24th of 36 WRs in his class with stats.
